toolPanel.scaleEvenlyTip: Changing one box changes the other two by as much, so the shape keeps its proportions
toolPanel.measureStartTouch: Tap a face, edge, circle or corner. Tap a second one to measure between them.
toolPanel.measureStart: Point at a face, edge, circle or corner and click it. Click a second one to measure between them.
toolPanel.measureSecondTouch: Now tap a second feature to measure the distance and angle.
toolPanel.measureSecond: Now click a second feature to measure the distance and angle.
toolPanel.measureAgainTouch: Tap another feature to start a new measurement.
toolPanel.measureAgain: Click another feature to start a new measurement.
toolPanel.measureKeys: Esc lets go of the last pick, Delete starts over.
toolPanel.moveHint: Drag an arrow, or drag the object itself.
toolPanel.rotateHint: Drag a ring to turn the object around that axis.
toolPanel.scaleHint: Drag a handle; the centre box scales evenly.
toolPanel.flattenHint: Tap or click a highlighted face to lay the object flat on it.
toolPanel.groupMoveBoth: Drag an arrow, or drag one of them, or type below to move both chosen objects together.
toolPanel.groupMoveAll: Drag an arrow, or drag one of them, or type below to move all {{n}} chosen objects together.
toolPanel.groupRotateBoth: Drag a ring or type below to rotate both chosen objects together about their middle.
toolPanel.groupRotateAll: Drag a ring or type below to rotate all {{n}} chosen objects together about their middle.
toolPanel.groupScaleBoth: Drag a handle or type below to scale both chosen objects together about their middle.
toolPanel.groupScaleAll: Drag a handle or type below to scale all {{n}} chosen objects together about their middle.
toolPanel.volumeMove: Drag an arrow or type below to change {{name}} inside its object (from its middle). Pick the object in the list to work on all of it.
toolPanel.volumeRotate: Drag a ring or type below to change {{name}} inside its object. Pick the object in the list to work on all of it.
toolPanel.volumeScale: Drag a handle or type below to change {{name}} inside its object. Pick the object in the list to work on all of it.
toolPanel.sinkHint: A Z below the bed sinks it into the bed; only what is above prints.
